items.title: the "Housewife" music video trend
items.creator: @janetabramian
items.body: people film a totally normal part of their day and act like it's a music video, set to Tate McRae's "Housewife." the sound passed 430K videos in under three weeks!!

items.title: "Peli De Terror" is the #1 song rn
items.creator: THE FAVORITES, Køddy G
items.body: it's at the top of TikTok's worldwide song chart this week, with about 27K new videos a day and growing fast.

items.title: "Thriller" is still going
items.creator: Michael Jackson
items.body: halloween is OVER and "Thriller" is still adding almost 39K new tiktoks a day, up 72% in a week. nobody's ready to let it go.

items.title: "mogging" is Collins' word of the year
items.body: announced today! it means outshining or upstaging someone, and it's huge with gen z and gen alpha. usage went up 210% this year. you can add it to anything too, like "carmogging."

items.title: "unc"
items.body: slightly mean gen z/alpha slang for an older person who's out of touch. it was a runner-up for dictionary.com's word of the year. we are probably unc.

items.title: "maxxing" won dictionary.com
items.body: official now: maxxing is dictionary.com's 2026 word of the year. it means optimizing something to the max, like "gymmaxxing."

items.title: the "bixie" haircut
items.body: shorter than a bob, longer than a pixie. it made Collins' word of the year shortlist. seeing it everywhere rn.
